import json
p=json.load(open('.ai/task/repair-w47a-20260927/CONTEXTUAL-ENVELOPE-r3a1.json'))
obs={72:'同条歌词四次出现的“They won\'t work on normal humans”明确指休眠仓不适用于普通人类；译文四次作“休眠仓对凡人没用”，把限制从普通人类扩大到所有凡人，连同歌词中的食人魔也会被排除，改变了休眠仓的适用对象。'}
v=[{'revision_key':k,'verdict':'ISSUE','observation':obs[i]} if i in obs else {'revision_key':k,'verdict':'OK'} for i,k in enumerate(p['payload']['ordered_revision_keys'])]
print(json.dumps({'contract':'translation_contextual_v2','candidate_identity':p['candidate_identity'],'verdicts':v},ensure_ascii=False,separators=(',',':')))
PY",workdir:"/workspace/tome4-chinese-translation",sandbox_permissions:"require_escalated",justification:"Generate the contract-required ordered JSON response from the user-authorized frozen keys.",max_output_tokens:6000});text(r.output)
